summary:
Iteration 20 — PWA frontend only (backend already verified by /app/backend/tests/test_pwa.py 9/9 pass). All requested scenarios verified end-to-end on the public URL https://matshop-3.preview.emergentagent.com.

1) Service worker: GET /sw.js registers (navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations -> 1 reg, scope '/'); after a hard reload navigator.serviceWorker.controller is set to /sw.js (page controlled). Manifest link /api/pwa/manifest.json returns 200 with name='MatShop.id', short_name='MatShop', 3 icons, start_url='/?source=pwa', display='standalone'.

2) Offline: with SW active, visited '/' and '/katalog' online, then set context offline. Re-navigation to /katalog renders the real cached page (navbar + Katalog headings + category list) — NOT offline-page, as spec expects. Never-visited '/never-visited-page-xyz' falls back to the cached app shell '/' (React Router 'No routes matched' warning only) — spec accepts 'app shell OR offline-page, not browser error', confirmed no browser net error.

3) Mobile 390px + iPhone Safari UA: install-banner appears ~2.5s after load; install-banner-title='Install aplikasi MatShop.id'; install-banner-button opens install-guide with install-guide-ios (iOS steps rendered); install-banner-close dismisses banner, writes localStorage mshop_install_dismissed (unix ms, 1792035807973), and after reload banner stays hidden. Desktop 1920 never shows install-banner (verified).

4) Logged-in user menu (desktop Chrome UA, no native prompt): user-menu-trigger -> menu-install-app opens install-guide with install-guide-android (correct fallback, since isIOS()==false on this UA).

5) Admin -> admin-tab-site -> site-pwa card: edited site-pwa-app_name='MatShop PWA Test', site-pwa-short_name='MSTest', site-pwa-banner_title='Pasang MatShop di HP', site-pwa-banner_text='Akses katalog lebih cepat'. Uploaded 1x1 PNG via site-pwa file input -> site-pwa-icon-preview src changed from '/icons/icon-512.png' to '/api/files/matshop/uploads/user_demo_admin/<uuid>.png'. site-pwa-icon-reset button appears after upload. Clicked site-save (PUT /api/admin/site-settings) -> /api/pwa/manifest.json immediately reflects {name:'MatShop PWA Test', short_name:'MSTest'}. Mobile iOS banner re-rendered with install-banner-title='Pasang MatShop di HP'.

6) Regression: pages load normally with SW active (title='MatShop.id'); demo login as buyer OK; demo login as admin OK (user-menu-trigger -> menu-admin -> /admin reachable); add-to-cart surface accessible from /katalog (page loads with product grid).

7) CLEANUP: PUT /api/admin/site-settings {images:{}, hero:{}, sections:[], pwa:{}} -> 200. Manifest reverted to defaults {name:'MatShop.id', short_name:'MatShop'}. No lingering state.
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js networkFirst for navigate falls back to caches.match('/') before offline.html — this means never-visited routes always get the app shell (SPA will attempt client-side route) rather than offline.html. Spec allows 'app shell OR offline-page' so this is acceptable; just note offline.html is effectively only shown if '/' itself was never cached (edge case).
sw.js caches '/api/files/' under IMAGES via staleWhileRevalidate only when destination==='image'; non-image file downloads bypass SW (correct for private files).
pwa.js registerSW is best-effort (.catch(() => {})) and silently swallows errors — add a console.warn in dev to help diagnose SW registration failures.
InstallBanner.jsx uses window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)') only once in the effect; if the window is resized the banner state is not re-evaluated. Minor since banner is mobile-only.
InstallBanner.jsx: dismiss key 'mshop_install_dismissed' is unprefixed/shared across all users on same device — intentional per spec (device-level dismiss) but worth documenting.
InstallGuide dialog uses onOpenChange + setGuide(false); when Escape pressed the dialog closes correctly (verified).

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only run; backend 9/9 from prior test_pwa.py)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested PWA flows (SW register+control, manifest, offline cached, mobile banner show/dismiss/persist, iOS install-guide, user-menu install, admin PWA edit + manifest+banner refresh, cleanup)

test_credentials: /api/auth/demo roles: buyer, admin (used demo-login-buyer and demo-login-admin via /login page)
seed_data_creation: Uploaded one 1x1 transparent PNG via /api/uploads during admin PWA icon test (stored as /matshop/uploads/user_demo_admin/<uuid>.png). Reset via site-pwa-icon-reset then full cleanup via PUT /api/admin/site-settings with empty pwa object — manifest confirmed back to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test mobile banner you MUST create a NEW browser context with iPhone UA + viewport 390x844 + is_mobile=True (not just set_viewport_size), otherwise InstallBanner isIOS()==false and canPrompt==false so banner never shows. Delay for banner is 2500ms (use >=3200ms wait). The close button writes localStorage mshop_install_dismissed= Date.now() ms; banner reappears after 7 days (WEEK=7*24*3600*1000). Promo popup appears per session on first visit — close via [data-testid=promo-popup-close]. For admin UI, go to /admin -> click [data-testid=admin-tab-site] -> scroll to [data-testid=site-pwa]; file input is the single input[type=file] inside the site-pwa card (ImagesField testid='site-pwa-icon'). Manifest endpoint is /api/pwa/manifest.json (dynamic, reads site_settings.pwa). Backend PWA tests at /app/backend/tests/test_pwa.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — all PWA features work end-to-end.
